commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
Improve Confluence search with AND-based token matching and recency scoring

- Fix Confluence base URL missing /wiki path (was routing to JIRA)
- Add 'order by lastmodified desc' to CQL queries for recency
- Change broader search to AND logic (require ALL significant tokens)
- Add recency bonus scoring (up to +15 points for recent pages)
- Add fallback search strategies when AND is too restrictive
- Update system prompt v1.13.0 with clear capabilities list
- Update test to reflect new title-contains search behavior
